Strategy: Avoid creating a new tightest residual: give a bonus to placements whose leftover stays above the current minimum residual, so the smallest leftover is never made smaller. It may help by not manufacturing dead slivers, but may fail by shunning the tight placements that Best Fit relies on.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item > min(bins) else 0) for r in bins]
```
